news.title: RAIN finalizes a pilot-ready deployment framework
news.summary: A three-phase rollout model now covers site discovery, treatment calibration, and monitoring handover for first-stage partners.
news.content: The framework is designed for public and industrial partners that need a visible path from water capture to measured service delivery.

news.title: New dashboard logic focuses on traceability, not just telemetry
news.summary: RAIN's interface now organizes quality checkpoints, usage logs, and readiness states in one partner-facing view.
news.content: The goal is to make treatment outcomes and commercial usage understandable to operators, procurement teams, and sustainability leads.

news.title: Construction and municipal landscaping remain the fastest entry points
news.summary: These categories combine repetitive water demand, visible sustainability pressure, and simpler non-potable acceptance paths.
news.content: RAIN uses these segments to accelerate commercial proof while keeping the system modular enough for agriculture and industrial operations.

sectors.name: Construction
sectors.use_case: Concrete support, dust suppression, site washing
sectors.summary: RAIN reduces freshwater dependency on active sites where water demand is repetitive, visible, and often expensive.
applications: Dust suppression across active work zones
Temporary site cleaning and vehicle wash points
benefits: Fast pilot fit for project-based operations

sectors.name: Agriculture

Stronger resource planning across crop cycles

sectors.name: Industry

benefits: Better ESG positioning for resource management

sectors.name: Municipalities

layers.title: Collection Layer
layers.summary: Capture rain where it falls using roofs, channels, collectors, and event-based routing decisions.
items: Roof catchment and modular collector sets
Surface water routing for urban and industrial layouts
Reservoir feed logic based on rainfall events
Input sensors for visibility at the start of the chain

layers.title: Processing Layer
layers.summary: Filter, sterilize, and stabilize water quality for recurring non-potable use.
items: UV sterilization for consistent treatment output
Reservoir and treatment management with IoT oversight

layers.title: RaaS Platform
layers.summary: Turn water infrastructure into a measurable service with access, usage, and operational controls.
items: Order flow, account tracking, and service logs
Water quality dashboard with threshold views
Usage-based pricing readiness and billing logic

faq.question: What does RAIN sell?
faq.answer: RAIN sells managed non-potable water capability: infrastructure, treatment logic, monitoring visibility, and service operations packaged together.

faq.question: Why does the product start with non-potable demand?
faq.answer: It accelerates adoption in sectors where water is operationally important but does not need drinking-water certification.

faq.question: How does the platform create revenue?
faq.answer: The model supports subscription retainers, volume-based charging, and premium service tiers tied to monitoring and reporting depth.

faq.question: Can the system work for both private and public operators?
faq.answer: Yes. The operating model is intentionally structured for enterprise, municipal, and project-based environments.
